name: Mitsuryouku
source:
The town is under attack of foreign nation soldiers. They gather the riches and violate women on their way.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-august-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
該鎮正受到外國士兵的攻擊。他們在途中掠奪財富並侵犯婦女。
